text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan receives Palestinian President Yasser Arafat after Washington summit; second visit by Arafat since Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu took power.
- Spain and Morocco to reinforce cooperation against illegal immigration and drug trafficking.
- Intransigence of Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu threatens to increase tension in Palestinian territories.
- Morocco's fishing industry association to battle foreign pillage of Moroccan fish stocks, through close cooperation with navy.
- Failure at Palestinian-Israeli summit in Washington.
- Pursuit of Middle East peace process at centre of talks between Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Moroccan King Hassan.
- Moroccan Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj re-elected president of development committee of World Bank/International Monetary Fund.
